modification_notice: The distributed model.onnx is a deterministic export from the pinned original safetensors, using FP16 weights, an eager encoder and FP32 Sigmoid output. All 393 original tensors are bound in one graph file; no external runtime tensors are required. It is not a vendor-provided ONNX graph. This companion builder only verifies and packages the approved prepared files.
quality_notice: Hash verification establishes artifact identity, not retrieval quality. Numerical comparison is not retrieval-quality proof, and same-precision and original-FP32 results are reported separately without changing tolerances. No universal relevance probability or production-quality certification is asserted. Consumed independent v22 and v27 failures are preserved; the next unused independent release evaluation has not run.
